answer: The orchard chain is verified at intake and violet publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 4 epochs old, anchored at a mirror checkpoint. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 4 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. The attacker spends 70 dollars and 6 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
